title: Latent shift adaptation
summary: Implements 'Adapting to Latent Subgroup Shifts via Concepts and Proxies' (AISTATS 2023): methods for keeping classifiers reliable when an unobserved subgroup's prevalence shifts between training and deployment, using concept and proxy variables, with a discrete eigendecomposition approach and continuous spectral/WAE variants. Meridian wants it as a drift-robustness layer for platform models.
